False cart path: traced along the dark edge of the spruce shadow east of the hole 1 White/Red decks (E 731-744, N 815-846). No path in RGB or NIR; burn with the surrounding rough.

False tee pad (67 m2) in the rough left of the hole 1 fairway start (E 685-692, N 952-968): irregular blob, no deck in the LiDAR, no mown box in the photo, not an OSM tee and no card tee is at that distance (364 yd).

Blue tee deck is larger than the traced pad: the 2018 LiDAR deck is flat at 353.0 m from N 780.5 to N 795-797 (north edge tilts up to the east) and the photo shows the mown box E 728.5-740.5; the model pad stops at N 791.6. Verifier: SW corner clipped ~1 m to the edge of the asphalt cart-park strip west of the tee (NDVI edge), so the pad does not cover pavement.

Closes a semirough pocket (about 28 m2, E 599.5-607.5, N 4811134.7-4811147.2) between the left edge of the hole 1 fairway and a fairway finger in the tree shadow. In the 2025 photo the mown, striped fairway runs unbroken across it to the shadow line at about E 600; the pocket is an artefact of the shadow. Fill = morphological closing (2 m) of the fairway, minus the fairway. [QA round 2, verified]

Leaf litter, not a mulch bed: the 26 m2 'native' patch at E 714-721.5, N 4810920-4810927 lies in the bare deciduous grove NE of the hole 1 forward tees. In the photo it is the same brown leaf litter with trunk shadows as the woodland floor around it (rough, hole 99); it survived the under-canopy rule only because it sits in a gap between crowns (CHM 0 inside). Round 1 reported the same patch. [QA round 2, verified]

False bunker on pavement: the 17.6 m2 hole-99 'bunker' at E 716-723.5, N 4810756-4810765.5 is the paved walk that links the upper and lower parking lots below the hole 1 Blue tee. At 4 cm/px the photo shows a smooth grey slab with a stone edging on the mulch-bed side and a joint where it meets the lower-lot asphalt; NDVI is about 0, and its RGB (143-148/135-138/114-116) is darker than any bunker sand (194-203). In the LiDAR it is a smooth 6.5 % ramp between the two lots, not a hollow. 'road' is not an override surface, so it becomes paved cart path (hole 98), like the adjoining cart-path polygon at E 724-788.
